segments.pv42:1.1: Pubbe katānaṃ kammānaṃ, vipāko mathaye manaṃ;
segments.pv42:1.3: Rūpe sadde rase gandhe, phoṭṭhabbe ca manorame.
segments.pv42:2.1: Naccaṃ gītaṃ ratiṃ khiḍḍaṃ, anubhutvā anappakaṃ;
segments.pv42:4.3: Tassa pattaṃ gahetvāna, uccaṃ paggayha khattiyo.
segments.pv42:5.3: “Rañño kitavassāhaṃ putto, kiṃ maṃ bhikkhu karissasi”.
segments.pv42:6.1: Tassa kammassa pharusassa, vipāko kaṭuko ahu;
segments.pv42:8.3: Uddhaṃpādo ṭhito ceva, ciraṃ bālo apaccatha.
segments.pv42:11.1: So tattha bahuvassāni, vedayitvā bahuṃ dukhaṃ;
segments.pv42:11.3: Khuppipāsahato nāma [khuppipāsāhato nāma (sī. pī)], peto āsi tato cuto.
segments.pv42:13.1: Diṭṭheva dhamme pāsaṃso, yo buddhesu sagāravo;
segments.pv42:13.3: Kāyassa bhedā sappañño, saggaṃ so upapajjatīti.

words: pubbe katānaṃ kammānaṃ  vipāko mathaye manaṃ
lines: Tattha pubbe katānaṃ kammānaṃ, vipāko mathaye mananti purimāsu jātīsu katānaṃ akusalakammānaṃ phalaṃ uḷāraṃ hutvā uppajjamānaṃ andhabālānaṃ cittaṃ mathayeyya abhibhaveyya, paresaṃ anatthakaraṇamukhena attano atthaṃ uppādeyyāti adhippāyo.
Idāni taṃ cittamathanaṃ visayena saddhiṃ dassetuṃ “rūpe sadde”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Tattha rūpeti rūpahetu, yathicchitassa manāpiyassa rūpārammaṇassa paṭilābhanimittanti attho.
Evaṃ sādhāraṇato vuttamatthaṃ asādhāraṇato niyametvā dassento “naccaṃ gītan”tiādimāha.
Uñche pattagate ratanti uñchena bhikkhācārena laddhe pattagate pattapariyāpanne āhāre rataṃ santuṭṭhaṃ.
Laddhā, bhanteti cābravīti “api, bhante, bhikkhā laddhā”ti vissāsajananatthaṃ kathesi.

words: rañño kitavassāhaṃ putto  kiṃ maṃ bhikkhu karissasī
lines: Thaṇḍile pattaṃ bhinditvāti kharakaṭhine bhūmippadese khipanto pattaṃ bhinditvā.
Apasakkanto ca “akāraṇeneva andhabālo mahantaṃ anatthaṃ attano akāsī”ti karuṇāyanavasena olokentaṃ paccekabuddhaṃ rājaputto āha “rañño kitavassāhaṃ putto, kiṃ maṃ bhikkhu karissasī”ti.

Chaḷeva caturāsīti, vassāni nahutāni cāti uttāno nipanno caturāsītivassasahassāni, nikujjo, vāmapassena, dakkhiṇapassena, uddhaṃpādo, olambiko, yathāṭhito cāti evaṃ cha caturāsītisahassāni vassāni honti.
Uddhaṃpādo ṭhito ceva, ciraṃ bālo apaccathā”ti.
Tāni pana vassāni yasmā anekāni nahutāni honti, tasmā vuttaṃ “nahutānī”ti.
Pūgānīti vassasamūhe, idha purimagāthāya ca accantasaṃyoge upayogavacanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Appaduṭṭhappadosinaṃ isiṃ subbataṃ āsajja āsādetvā pāpakammantā puggalā evarūpaṃ kaṭukaṃ ativiya dukkhaṃ paccantīti yojanā.
